## gcode_macro HOME_ALL

Clear mesh, home and retreat Y, home and retreat X, then home Z through native safe_z_home. Each XY helper waits for stall detection to clear. This is not a tap wrapper.

**Calls and state references:** [_HOME_X_SENSORLESS](homing.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_home_x_sensorless), [_HOME_Y_SENSORLESS](homing.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_home_y_sensorless). Conditional references are not necessarily executed.

<a id="gcode_macro-_home_y_sensorless"></a>

## gcode_macro _HOME_Y_SENSORLESS

Wait two seconds, home Y to its positive endstop and retreat to Y360 at 20mm/s. Wait for retreat motion to finish before returning.

| Source line | Code | Plain explanation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [10](../../config/macros/homing.cfg#L10) | <code>[gcode_macro _HOME_Y_SENSORLESS]</code> | Declare this callable macro. |
| [11](../../config/macros/homing.cfg#L11) | <code>gcode:</code> | Begin the command template. The following indented lines belong to it. |
| [12](../../config/macros/homing.cfg#L12) | <code>G4 P2000</code> | Wait for <code>P2000</code> (P is milliseconds; 1000 ms = 1 second). |
| [13](../../config/macros/homing.cfg#L13) | <code>G28 Y</code> | Home <code>Y</code> using the native homing path. Here safe_z_home handles Z positioning; this is not a standalone tap command. |
| [14](../../config/macros/homing.cfg#L14) | <code>G90</code> | Use absolute XYZ coordinates for following moves. This does not move the printer or independently change M82/M83. |
| [15](../../config/macros/homing.cfg#L15) | <code>G1 Y360 F1200</code> | command Y=<code>360</code> mm; use feed rate 20 mm/s (1200 mm/min). XYZ follows G90/G91; E follows G91/M82/M83. Omitted axes and feed rate retain their previous values. |
| [16](../../config/macros/homing.cfg#L16) | <code>M400</code> | Wait until queued movement has completed before continuing. |

## gcode_macro _REQUIRE_HOMED

<a id="gcode_macro-center"></a>

## gcode_macro CENTER

Require homing and move the nozzle to X175 Y175, preserving the caller's G-code modes. It does not change Z or return to the original XY position.

**Calls and state references:** [_REQUIRE_HOMED](homing.cfg.md#gcode_macro-_require_homed). Conditional references are not necessarily executed.
